description: Magic2 Mappa della gerarchizzazione dei punti di criticità (PC): Mar Tirreno meridionale, Canale di sicilia, Mar Ionio Occidentale. (RNDT-Dataset) - Versione 2.0 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by protezionecivile.gov.it. This document is a map (GeoTIFF) representing Criticity Points (PCs) mapped in the Magic1 project and their hierarchisation (executed in the Magic2 project). In particular this map shows the sector of the southern Tyrrhenian Sea, the Sicilian Channel and the Western Ionian Sea. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Magic2 Map of Critical Points Hierarchisation (PC): Southern Tyrrhenian Sea, Sicilian Channel, Western Ionian Sea. (RNDT" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, Suscettività della costa, Coste italiane, sicilia_calabria_classif PC, Dati multibeam, Punti di criticità. The listing shows 2 download or service links in TIFF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
